column1: # cdef_i16_kernel_2026-09-05 — the AVX2 dst8 CDEF filter rewritten in C's shape
# (i16 lanes, 16/cols rows per 256-bit register, taps grouped by coefficient),
# and the cols==4 shapes given a vector path instead of the scalar core.
# See the companion .meta for the mechanism, the exactness argument and the traps.
# base = main@origin e622a99c2 (the CfL SIMD commit)
#        Every row ident=Y (uninstrumented pre-pass AND both instrumented runs).
#        NOTE valgrind masks AVX-512, so C's arms here are its AVX2 ones.
# WALL = tools/perf_ab.sh, 21 interleaved randomised paired rounds, one untimed
#        warmup per sample, NEITHER SIDE NICED, r7900x quiet (load 1.25, ps showed
#        lane's own perf_ab started 08:23, AFTER these runs finished.
# SECOND wall-clock pass + a SAME-BINARY CONTROL, taken together in one session
# on a verifiably quiet r7900x (uptime 0.02/0.24/0.82 before, 1.03/0.75/0.90
# after; `ps -eo pcpu,comm --sort=-pcpu` top entry 3.2 % plymouthd both times).
# The control runs `perf_ab.sh base base` — identical binary in both slots — so
# its ratio IS this harness's floor for these cells on this host.
